record.original_question: Classify all K-derivations of general type on the polynomial ring R=K[x,y], where “general type” means that both the ring of constants A_0={x in R : δ(x)=0} and the field of constants L_0={ξ in Q(R) : δ(ξ)=0} equal K. Describe such derivations in terms of the associated δ-integral ring A.

evidence.quote: QUESTION 2. Classify all K-derivations of general type on R = K[x, y] and describe them in terms of the δ-integral ring A.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero and let $R = K[x,y]$ be the polynomial ring in two variables. For a $K$-derivation $\delta : R \to R$, define:
- the ring of constants $A_0 = \{f \in R : \delta(f) = 0\}$,
- the field of constants $L_0 = \{\xi \in Q(R) : \delta(\xi) = 0\}$, where $Q(R) = K(x,y)$ is the field of fractions of $R$,
- the $\delta$-integral ring $A = \{\xi \in L_0 : \xi \text{ is integral over } R\} = L_0 \cap \overline{R}$, where $\overline{R}$ denotes the integral closure of $R$ in $Q(R)$ (equivalently, in some algebraic closure).

Call $\delta$ a $K$-derivation of general type when $A_0 = K$ and $L_0 = K$.

Classify all $K$-derivations of general type on $R = K[x,y]$, and describe them in terms of the associated $\delta$-integral ring $A$.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a definitive classification of $K$-derivations of general type on $K[x,y]$ in terms of the $\delta$-integral ring. While there is substantial literature on derivations and rings of constants of $K[x,y]$ (e.g., work of Nowicki on polynomial derivations and their rings of constants), no source clearly resolves this specific classification problem, so its current status could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial derivations and their rings of constants (Nowicki)
status_evidence.snippet: Monograph on rings of constants of polynomial derivations, including the two-variable case.
status_evidence.claim: General reference on derivations of K[x,y] and their constants, but does not state a definitive classification of general-type derivations via the delta-integral ring.

status_evidence.title: A class of simple derivations of polynomial ring k[x1,...,xn]
status_evidence.snippet: Studies simple derivations of polynomial rings in several variables.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on related but distinct classification questions; does not resolve the general-type classification problem.
